faq.q: How are pool builders listed here?
faq.a: Every listing comes from public business records and Google Maps. We keep businesses that are open, have reviews, and do this work as their main trade. Owners can claim a listing to correct details or add photos.

faq.q: Do you charge businesses to be listed?
faq.a: No. A basic listing is free and stays free. Businesses can pay for a featured position or a premium listing, and those are marked as such.
